reasoning.structure: The analysis report follows a logical structure, covering all required sections: Executive Summary, Budget & Efficiency, Results & Value, Risks, and Channel Notes. It systematically discusses each aspect with clear subpoints and evidence, maintaining coherence and completeness.

key_issues: Lack of specific recommended actions or next steps to improve campaign performance.
Absence of landing page view data, which limits understanding user engagement post-click.
No segmentation analysis to identify which demographics or keywords perform better.
improvement_suggestions: Add concrete optimization recommendations, such as audience refinement or creative testing.
Include landing page engagement metrics if available to assess user quality after clicks.
Suggest segmentation or targeting strategies to improve CTR and conversion rates.
